definition: relationships better early and harder with tenure, and the three accounts of why

settled:
Across four jobs, of four, four, two and five years, and every move, my relationships were better early and got harder as the years accumulated.

A fresh start puts me back in the safe-stranger zone, which explains both why fresh starts appeal and why staying is hard.

The exact mechanism is uncertain, and it may be more than one thing.

My hard-learned social skill is tuned for the shallow end, so my maps get less accurate as a relationship deepens past what they were trained on.

People ask things of me, and through the isolated years I never had enough to give, so repeated giving past empty made people less safe over time.

And the corrections accumulate. Intimates correct me more, from good intent and without a map of my brain, so the triggers are laid down faster than the familiarity banks safety.
